title: News with read state: a dated diary that remembers, and a count in the menu
intent: News that remembers what was read
summary: A list of `<article>` entries with `<time datetime>` whose read state is one shape-checked localStorage record behind a probe and try/catch (memory, said in words, when storage is refused or a write fails); a first visit marks the 21 days before the newest entry new and a return visit gives later entries a quiet arrival; an entry is read when its `<details>` opens or after 1.2 s wholly in view below the measured sticky masthead once the visitor has scrolled; the menu link reads `News 3 new`, and a polite status speaks only for open and mark all
variants: read on open or dwell, a count in the menu, mark all (this, default)
read on open only: drop the dwell observer when entries are long and a glance is not a read
server-side: the same record keyed to a signed-in account, with localStorage as the offline copy
